expensesIntro.title: Expenses & Deductions
expensesIntro.infoCallout: Certain household expenses can reduce the income we count for your food assistance benefit — this may <bold>increase the amount you receive</bold>.
expensesIntro.noExpenses: I have no expenses to report

shelterCosts.title: Housing & Utility Costs
shelterCosts.subtitle: These costs help calculate your SNAP shelter deduction.
shelterCosts.totalRentHelper: The full rent amount for your unit, before splitting with roommates.
shelterCosts.yourShareHelper: The amount you personally pay each month. If you pay the full rent, enter the same amount above.
shelterCosts.rentDifferenceInfo: It looks like ${{difference}} is covered by others. Only your share (${{yourShare}}) will count toward your shelter deduction.
shelterCosts.rentShareWarning: Your share is higher than the total rent. Please double-check both amounts.
shelterCosts.mortgageHelper: Enter your regular monthly payment. Include homeowner's association fees if applicable.
shelterCosts.sharedCostQuestion: Is this cost shared with people outside your household?
shelterCosts.yourShareMonthlyCost: Your share of the monthly cost
shelterCosts.suaDescription: Most households qualify. Claiming the SUA is simpler than listing individual costs and is often the same amount or higher.
shelterCosts.suaTooltip: The SUA is a fixed monthly amount set by State-X HHS that covers typical utility costs. You don't need receipts.
shelterCosts.enterActualCosts: Or enter actual utility costs instead
shelterCosts.actualCostsHelper: Enter your average monthly costs. At least one field is required if you're itemizing.
shelterCosts.heating: Heating and cooling (gas, electric, oil, propane)
shelterCosts.phoneNote: At least one phone required for a separate phone deduction
shelterCosts.medicalExpensesNote: For household members 60+ or with disabilities. Only costs over $35/mo are deductible.
shelterCosts.docPromptRent: You listed monthly rent of ${{amount}} — a lease agreement can help speed up processing.
shelterCosts.docPromptMortgage: You listed a monthly mortgage of ${{amount}} — upload your mortgage statement to verify.

dependentCare.title: Dependent Care Costs
dependentCare.subtitle: Child care or adult dependent care that allows household members to work, attend school, or look for work.
dependentCare.gatingQuestion: Does anyone in your household pay for care of a child or disabled adult so they can work, look for work, or go to school?
dependentCare.noEligibleDependents: No eligible dependents found. Only children under 13, adults 60+, or members with a disability can be listed here. Check that household members are entered correctly.
dependentCare.deductibleNote: Only costs paid so others in your household can work, attend school, or look for work are deductible.
